name: Nakul Iyer
headline: I lead products with AI, and build them too.
intro: I've spent seven years leading product on client programs: airline and grocer loyalty apps, retail data, consent capture and hospital nurse scheduling. Now I also build my own apps and games with AI.

pillars.title: Product lead on client programs
pillars.body: Discovery, requirements and release planning with design, engineering, security and testing teams, for clients in travel, retail, privacy and healthcare.

pillars.title: AI in how teams build software
pillars.body: I look at where AI changes a client's delivery, choose the tools, define new ways of working and pilot them with the teams.

pillars.title: Apps and games I build myself
pillars.body: Web apps, iOS apps and games, designed and shipped with AI. I can explain every layer of the stack.
